# Atulya Ventures

Atulya Ventures is a Consumer Services company. Atulya Ventures employs 2 people. Headquartered in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India.

## About

ATULYA VENTURES PVT LTD will be the first unique company into Rural Development and changing rural society an entrepreneurs. These entrepreneurs will be the company’s main distribution channels and each of them will be provided with a captured market through the company’s model named “AURUM” (Atulya Urban Rural United Model) which aspires to create a connect between 20000 Rural and 100 Urban Investors through AVPL.

Key Factors of Our Approach :-

> Meeting the financial products and services needs of unserved and underserved retail customers through all possible channels

> Attracting and retaining a diverse workforce and providing a collaborative work environment that fosters innovation

> Building sustainable, collaborative, strategic partnerships to develop a global ecosystem

OUR VISION :-

We envision a rural population composed mostly of proud and successful entrepreneurs. ATULYA VENTURES PVT LTD wants to become the leading catalysts and business model provider for Rural to become highly motivated as well as effective entrepreneurs. Business Innovation through Social Inclusion.


OUR MISSION :

Our mission requires the highest ideals and dedication. Atulya Ventures desires to Convert every rural into a professional and effective entrepreneur. To be an innovator And implementer for increasing growth in new businesses which are uncharted in India. Innovating and putting our best efforts to connect Rural and Urban Services and Products is the theme around which our business growth is defined.
